model: Sum-of-parts: owner-FCF DCF on attributable industrial operations (proportionate KLHL) plus property, securities and JV assets in the equity bridge (engine route)

inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash flow statement: no share-based payment line (FY2024 comparative 124.0m). Kingboard's options vest on the date of grant (interim note 13, 'no vesting period'), so the full fair value is expensed only in grant years: FY2017 3.1m, FY2019 229.2m, FY2022 125.3m, FY2023 124.0m; the zero years (FY2018, FY2020, FY2021, FY2024, FY2025) are genuine no-grant years, not a disclosure gap. Forward charge is the nine-year average, ~53.5m/yr = 0.12% of revenue, applied every year.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T08:08:05Z regular close (HKEX; last trading session before valuation date)
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted, gross method: 1,121.78m shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (share capital HK$112,178k at HK$0.10 par) + 17.98m vested in-the-money options outstanding (15.56m at HK$21.50, 2.42m at HK$30.89; interim note 13) = 1,139.76m; option exercise proceeds of HK$409m added in the equity bridge. Held flat: SBC is expensed in the flows. Buyback cash nil in FY2024-25 (11.9m in FY2023), so the flat count is a modelling convention, not something the company funds.
inputs.wacc_rationale: HKD build (HKD pegged to USD; flows are RMB/HKD/USD, mostly RMB-denominated China manufacturing). Risk-free 3.5% (HK 10y govt / UST proxy), equity risk premium 6.0% for China-exposed HK equities, beta 1.15 (cyclical electronic materials) -> cost of equity ~10.4%; after-tax cost of debt ~2.5% (HIBOR+0.5-1.0%, LPR-1.1%) at ~20% debt weight -> base WACC ~9.0-9.5%. SANITY-CHECK FIX (2026-10-11): +1.0pp cyclicality premium added -> 10.5%, held identical across scenarios. The original build charged cyclicality only in the paths (margin reversion, 30% bear weight); sanity_check.py tripped on implied P/E and EV/EBITDA and diagnosed wacc_too_low, and the premium is the low end of the +1-2pp template because the paths and bear weight already carry part of the cycle -- the full +2pp would double-count it. Applies to the industrial flows only; property, securities and JV marks in the equity bridge are unchanged.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), immaterial: lease liabilities of HK$15.9m (5.1m current + 10.8m non-current, 30 June 2026) are inside total_debt; no lease charge in the flows (lease_cost_pct 0).
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, by proportionate consolidation. The only material NCI is the 38.31% public float of Kingboard Laminates Holdings (KLHL, 1888.HK): the Group's stake fell from 71.10% to 66.95% (130m shares placed at HK$21.0 on 18 Mar 2026) and to 61.69% (155m shares at HK$76.0 on 17 Jun 2026). The revenue base and EBITDA margin include 61.69% of the Laminates division and 100% of PCBs, Chemicals and Others, so no NCI stock is deducted for the laminates flows. H1 2026 NCI profit share (996.8m of 3,708.2m) is consistent with ~33-38% of the laminates segment after tax, confirming PCBs/Chemicals are effectively wholly owned. Because net debt, property and securities are taken at consolidated 100%, the NCI share of KLHL's own non-operating net assets is deducted as an estimate in the equity bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL CHOICE: Kingboard straddles two routing rows -- an operating manufacturer (laminates incl. upstream glass yarn/fabric/copper foil, PCBs, chemicals) and a holdco carrying HK$27.0bn of investment property, HK$11.0bn of development property and a HK$22.7bn listed securities portfolio. Per dcf-methods SKILL.md it is valued as a sum of parts: the industrial divisions as an owner-FCF DCF (owner-fcf.md + adaptations: non-US, cyclical, NCI, excluded-income/matching-asset rule) and the non-operating assets at stated value with haircuts in the equity bridge. Consolidated revenue includes property (1,525.8m FY2025) and investment income (541.2m FY2025), and both are EXCLUDED from base_revenue because their source assets are in the bridge (matching-asset rule). FY0 BASE: FY2025 attributable industrial external revenue = 0.6169 x Laminates 16,911.3 + PCBs 13,314.4 + Chemicals 12,654.6 + Others 427.7 = 36,829.3m (FY2025 AR note 6). Attributable divisional EBITDA = 0.6169 x 3,770 + 2,225.5 + 1,038.3 + ~43 = 5,632.5m (15.3%); attributable D&A 2,018m (5.5%); attributable capital additions 3,494m (9.5%). FY0 tie-out: modelled attributable industrial NOPAT ~3.1bn vs reported attributable NI 4,401.6m less investment segment (+3,016m, mostly 2.6bn FV gains), plus property loss (-944m incl. 1,321m PUD write-down) and after-tax finance cost -- within noise. YEAR 1 (FY2026) is judged from the H1 2026 interim: Laminates EBITDA +172% to 4,458.9m on revenue +55%, July 2026 laminates profit ~1.1bn for the single month (vs ~0.66bn/month H1 average), PCBs EBITDA 1,224m (+1%), Chemicals 771.9m (+68%). FY2026E attributable revenue ~49.5bn (+34%), EBITDA ~11.2bn (22.7%). TIMING: FY0 is FY2025 while the balance sheet is 30 June 2026, so H1 2026 flows sit both in the balance sheet and in year 1; H1 2026 FCF was negative (OCF 2,473.7m less ~3.2bn capex), so the overlap is conservative. last_fcf/reported_fcf are the consolidated FY2025 figures (OCF 4,738.8m less PP&E purchases 2,806.1m) for audit; the engine rebuilds the attributable industrial flow from drivers. Net debt 30 June 2026: bank borrowings 30,853.5m + leases 15.9m - cash 11,333.9m = 19,535.6m (net gearing 22% per interim); a HK$6bn 5-year syndicated loan was arranged in July 2026 (refinancing, not counted). MARKET LOOK-THROUGH MEMO: the Group's ~1.94bn KLHL shares (61.69% of ~3.15bn) are worth ~HK$95bn at KLHL's own quote, i.e. ~HK$84 per Kingboard share before PCBs, Chemicals, property or securities -- Kingboard trades at a deep discount to its listed stake. This valuation does NOT mark KLHL to market: KLHL's price embeds the AI up-cycle at its steepest point, and the house view values the laminates on flows with margin reversion.
inputs.price_volatility_note: Extreme volatility: 52-week range 25.1-151.8 (Yahoo meta). The stock roughly quadrupled into mid-June 2026 on the AI laminate/fibreglass shortage and MSCI China inclusion, then fell ~60% in four weeks. The price used is a regular close, not an after-hours print.

equity_bridge.item: Investment properties at fair value less 20% haircut
equity_bridge.note: 30 June 2026 balance sheet 26,980.7m (IAS 40 fair value; FY2025 FV loss 659m, rental income 1,328.5m FY2025 = ~4.9% gross yield). Haircut for China/eastern-region commercial property marks that keep falling and holdco illiquidity. Rental income excluded from flows.

equity_bridge.item: Properties held for development at book less 30% haircut
equity_bridge.note: 11,029.7m at 30 June 2026 (cost less write-downs; 1,320.8m PUD write-down FY2025, 323.5m H1 2025). No land bank additions for seven years; leasing-over-sale strategy. Haircut for continued PRC residential price declines and LAT.

equity_bridge.item: Listed securities portfolio at fair value
equity_bridge.note: Equity FVTPL 18,860.5m current + 2,089.3m non-current, debt FVTOCI 1,772.6m (interim 'approximately HK$22,722 million'). Mostly HK Main Board blue chips and bonds; dividend/interest income (investments segment) excluded from flows. Management states the portfolio recovered after the late-June correction.

equity_bridge.item: Interests in joint ventures and associate at book
equity_bridge.note: JVs 2,425.8m + associate 456.3m at 30 June 2026; share of results excluded from flows (EBITDA is divisional).
FY2025 final + special dividend and dividends to subsidiaries' NCI declared but unpaid at the balance sheet date; a cash claim not in net debt.

equity_bridge.item: NCI share of KLHL non-operating net assets (estimate)
equity_bridge.note: ESTIMATE, not disclosed in Kingboard's filings: KLHL holds part of the Group's property and securities and carries part of its debt, all of which the bridge and net debt take at 100%. ~38.3% of an assumed ~HK$8bn of KLHL non-operating net assets. Refine from KLHL (1888.HK) accounts if researched.
15.56m x HK$21.50 + 2.42m x HK$30.89; pairs with the 17.98m options in shares_outstanding.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 2.97% diverges >30% from EPS 5yr (-1.39%) and revenue 5yr (0.84%); FY2020 (base) and FY2021 were the prior laminate up-cycle, so every 5-year rate runs peak-to-mid-cycle. Equity CAGR also excludes the 12.8bn surplus booked on the 2026 KLHL placings (H1 2026). The forward path is not set from any historical CAGR: year 1-2 come from the H1 2026 run-rate and the stated capacity programme, later years from mid-cycle margins.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF less SBC (interest income not deducted: the Group is net debt every year). SBC is lumpy (grant-year expensing) and immaterial, so owner and reported FCF CAGRs barely differ. FCF collapsed from 8.0bn (FY2020) to 1.9bn (FY2025) because capital additions ran 4-5bn/yr (acetic acid Hebei, caustic soda Beihai, PCB Vietnam/Thailand, glass yarn kilns) against flat revenue; FY2018 includes a HK$2,090m one-off subsidiary-disposal gain and is not used as a base.

base.rationale: FY2026 from H1 actuals plus a stronger H2 (July laminates profit ~1.1bn/month); FY2027 volume from commissioned capacity (Shaoguan 70kt yarn, Qingyuan kilns, 95m/150m/78m-metre fabric lines, Kaiping laminates) with pricing still firm; FY2028-29 industry supply response normalises glass-fabric and laminate prices, revenue dips and margins revert to a 17.5% mid-cycle (above the ~15% FY2024-25 level for the higher AI/high-end mix). Capex stays elevated through FY2027 on the announced programme, then settles slightly above D&A. WC capture -25% matches ~87 net working-capital days. Cash tax 18% rising to 20% (HNTE 15% plants, 25% statutory, 5-10% PRC dividend withholding). At 10.5% WACC and 2.0% terminal growth Gordon (~12x) now binds marginally under the 12x cyclical cap; terminal EV/EBITDA ~5.6x sits inside the 10-year range 3.1-6.9x. SANITY-CHECK FIX (2026-10-11): years 5-10 growth cut from 2/4/4/3.5/3/3 to 1.5/2/2/2/2/2 and terminal growth 2.5 -> 2.0, because group revenue was flat over FY2018-25 (through-cycle CAGR ~0.6%) and post-normalisation growth should sit near inflation, not at the capacity-programme rate. Years 1-4 (the cycle shape) unchanged.

scenario_narratives.base: The AI-driven shortage of electronic glass yarn, glass fabric and HVLP/RTF copper foil carries FY2026 to a record (attributable industrial EBITDA ~11bn) and holds through FY2027 as Kingboard's vertically integrated capacity (five specialty yarn kilns going to 13, looms 3,333 to 5,833 by 2028) is absorbed at firm prices. From FY2028 the industry-wide fabric and laminate build-out catches up, prices normalise and divisional margins settle at a 17.5% mid-cycle that keeps some of the high-end mix gain. PCBs grow with the Vietnam/Thailand plants, chemicals gain from Beihai caustic soda and Hebei acetic acid. Property is worth less than its marks and is haircut; the securities portfolio is taken at fair value.
scenario_narratives.bull: AI materials prove structural rather than cyclical: low-Dk/low-CTE/quartz yarn and specialty fabric stay supply-constrained into 2028-29 because looms and kilns are genuinely scarce (management says high-performance looms are 'virtually impossible to source'), Kingboard keeps its certification lead with tier-one customers, laminates pricing holds and the mix shift lifts mid-cycle margins to ~21%. PCB overseas capacity (>3m sq ft/month) fills with AI-server and auto work.
scenario_narratives.bear: This is 2021 again. The FY2021 laminate boom (group EBITDA 17.8bn) was followed by margins halving within two years as supply arrived; the 2026 spike in glass-fabric and copper-foil prices draws the same response from Chinese competitors, AI capex digests, and laminate prices fall while Kingboard's newly commissioned kilns, looms and plants depress returns (D&A rises, utilisation falls). Margins fall to 14% (below the FY2024-25 trough level once mix is stripped out), revenue drops ~15% from the FY2027 level, and chemicals (caustic soda, acetic acid) see Chinese overcapacity pricing. Property marks keep sliding beyond the haircut.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30%: the valuation starts at the steepest point of a commodity-like up-cycle whose last instance (FY2021) reverted within two years, and the stock itself has just round-tripped ~4x and back. Base held at 50%: the H1 2026 numbers and July laminates profit are reported fact and the capacity programme is funded. Bull cut to 20%: it needs both structurally constrained AI-material supply and sustained pricing, two independent conditions.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Sum of the parts on a strict owner basis: the industrial divisions as an attributable (proportionate-KLHL) owner-FCF DCF that mean-reverts the 2026 AI laminate boom to a mid-cycle margin, plus property at haircut book, listed securities at fair value and JVs at book, less consolidated net debt, unpaid dividends and an estimate of the KLHL minority's share of KLHL's non-operating assets. SBC is tiny and lumpy (grant-date vesting) and is charged as a nine-year average. KLHL is deliberately NOT marked to its own market price, which would add ~HK$84/share for the stake alone.
valuation_philosophy.sanity_check_note: The multiples sanity check TRIPPED on the first build (weighted IV HK$71.33): implied P/E 18.0x vs a 10-year average of 8.0x (limit 2x = 15.9x) and implied EV/EBITDA 11.1x vs a 10-year maximum of 6.9x (limit 1.5x = 10.3x). One fix pass was applied, to the factory cash flows only: (1) a +1.0pp cyclicality premium on WACC (9.5% -> 10.5%, all scenarios), because a CCL/PCB maker at the top of an AI-driven up-cycle carries cycle risk a standard beta does not capture; (2) growth after normalisation (years 5-10) cut to near inflation (base 1.5-2.0%, bull 2.5-3.5%, bear 1.0-1.5%) and terminal growth to 2.0/2.5/1.5%, because group revenue was flat over FY2018-25. The exit cap (12x FCF, ~4.5-6.2x terminal EBITDA) was already inside the historical EV/EBITDA range and was left alone. Weighted IV fell to HK$67.27 and the check STILL TRIPS (P/E 17.1x, EV/EBITDA 10.6x). The remaining gap is structural to the sum of parts, not to the factory assumptions: about HK$44/share (HK$50bn) of the value is property, listed securities and JVs held in the equity bridge. Those assets add to the numerator of P/E and EV/EBITDA but earn little in EPS or EBITDA (rental ~1.3bn, dividends ~0.5bn, and FV losses on property). The stock has also always traded at a holdco discount (10-year P/B average 0.57x, maximum 0.98x), which the historical multiples build in. On the factories alone, weighted EV of ~HK$46bn is ~8.2x FY2025 attributable EBITDA (5.6bn, a trough-ish year) and ~4.1x FY2026E (~11.2bn). Read the IV as asset-backed value that assumes the market eventually credits the property and securities near book. It is not a claim that the industrial business deserves 17x earnings. If the holdco discount persists, value converges toward the bear case (HK$48.7).
key_risks_to_valuation: Cycle timing: year 1-2 margins (22-24%) are near the FY2021 peak; if prices roll over in 2027 rather than 2028 the base case is too high (bear case).

Non-operating assets are ~HK$52bn gross in the bridge (property 38bn at book, securities 22.7bn at fair value) -- roughly two-thirds of the equity value -- and PRC property marks and HK equity prices move faster than the flows.

Holdco discount: the market has priced Kingboard at 0.26-0.98x book for a decade; the SOTP credits the non-operating assets near (haircut) book, which is why the implied group multiples sit above every historical year even after the sanity-check fix.
NCI estimate: KLHL's share of property, securities and debt is not disclosed in Kingboard's filings; the HK$3bn deduction is an assumption.
Governance and capital allocation: family control, a large discretionary equity portfolio, and capex running far above D&A since FY2021 with FCF falling from 8.0bn to 1.9bn.
Timing overlap: FY0 is FY2025 while net debt is at 30 June 2026.
